title: Unboxing at desk
prompt_en: Vertical 9:16 first-person view. Hands open a cardboard box on a desk, lift out tissue paper and reveal a small speaker. Warm desk lamp light, casual room background slightly blurred, handheld.
prompt_zh: 竖屏 9:16 第一人称视角。双手在桌上打开纸箱，拿起包装纸，露出一个小音箱。温暖台灯光，随意的房间背景轻微虚化，手持拍摄。
why_it_works: Point-of-view unboxing avoids face consistency issues and mirrors a familiar creator format.
